zxxdev/dispelglow.description: World of Warcraft 3.3.5a (Wrath of the Lich King) addon: enemy Magic buffs glow on your target and focus frames when your character can purge or dispel them.

image.alt: An enemy target frame in the game, with its health bar, resource bar and portrait. Below them, the buffs that are Magic effects have a bright yellow border around their icons; the other buffs have none.

zxxdev/retailarenacountdown.description: World of Warcraft 3.3.5a (Wrath of the Lich King) addon: the modern arena countdown, with big numbers, sounds and your faction's crest when the gates open. Works without Gladdy.

image.alt: The addon's own images on a dark background: the number 45 in golden two-digit form, a larger single 3, and the Alliance crest, labelled 60 to 10 seconds, 9 to 1, and gates open.

zxxdev/trailmate.description: Leveling coach addon for World of Warcraft: Forever: quest guides, its own arrow and map marks, talents, dungeons and an optional AI companion chat. Alpha.
